infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plotwright uses your location to find your property and to trace its boundary as you walk it. Your location stays on your device.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Plotwright listens for readings broadcast by your garden and weather sensors. It doesn't connect to other devices or track your location.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Plotwright reads your weather station directly over your home Wi-Fi when you choose local mode.
